fields.BULLETIN TYPE: Private Placement-Non-Brokered, Property Asset or Share Purchase Agreement, Graduation from NEX to TSX Venture, Symbol Change, Resume Trading
fields.Private Placement-Non-Brokered: TSX Venture Exchange (the "Exchange") has accepted for filing documentation with respect to a Non-Brokered Private Placement announced on June 12, 2026.
fields.Warrant Exercise Terms: $0.10 per Listed Share for a two-year period.
fields.Disclosure: Refer to the Company's news releases dated June 12, 2026, July 30, 2026, October 27, 2026 and November 4, 2026. Property Asset or Share Purchase Agreement The Exchange has accepted for filing documentation with respect to the arm's length acquisition of the option (the "Option") to acquire 100% of the Crusader Property consisting of 5 mineral licenses prospective for uranium in Northern Saskatchewan, Canada, totaling approximately 2,771 hectares (the "Property"), pursuant to an option agreement (the "Option Agreement") entered into with the optionor (the "Optionor"). The Company has exercised the Option by paying to the Optionor $12,500 and issuing to the Optionor 7,000,000 Keon common shares. Refer to the Company's news release dated November 4, 2026 for further information. Graduation from NEX to TSX Venture, Symbol Change: Pursuant to recent filings made with the Exchange, the Company has met the requirements to be listed as a Tier 2 Company. Therefore, effective on Monday, November 9, 2026 the Company's listing will transfer from NEX to TSX Venture, the Company's Tier classification will change from NEX to Tier 2 and the Filing and Service Office will change from NEX to Vancouver. Refer to the Company's news release dated November 4, 2026 for further information. Effective at the opening, on Monday, November 9, 2026, the trading symbol for the Company will change from KEON.H to KEON. The Company is classified as a 'Mining' company.
fields.Capitalization: Unlimited shares with no par value of which 26,966,928 shares are issued and outstanding
fields.Escrow: Nil shares are subject to escrow Resume Trading Effective at the opening Monday November 9, 2026 trading in the Company's shares will resume.
